summary: Recon Technology filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-200 reverse share consolidation of its Class A ordinary shares, effective August 18, 2026. The board approved the consolidation on July 1, 2026, under authority from shareholders at the February 13, 2026 AGM. The ratio reduces issued shares from 192,644,726 to approximately 963,224. Fractional shares are rounded up; no cash paid. Authorized share capital is adjusted accordingly, with par value increasing from $0.0001 to $0.02 per share. Class B shares are unaffected. The stated purpose is to raise the per-share trading price to maintain Nasdaq listing. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation.
